name: Swarovski x Wmns Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Shadow'
story_html: The Swarovski x Women's Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Shadow' makes use of a grey leather upper, featuring Swarovski crystals embedded in the forefoot overlay, signature Swoosh and heel panel. A woven Nike Air tag adorns the tongue, while the iconic Wings logo is stamped on the back tab. Anchoring the sneaker is a durable rubber cupsole, enhanced with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the heel.
